messages:
Jordan (sales): FYI — prospect wants to include TelemetryPro SDK in an enterprise POC. They asked for security docs + CAIQ. Can eng-sec pick this up? Link: https://telemetrypro.example.com/docs/security :eyes:
Kira (eng-security): thanks. can you attach whatever they sent? we need CAIQ, SOC2, subprocessors, and dataflow diagram ideally. also any details on encryption/keys.
Jordan (sales): uploaded what they sent so far — partial CAIQ PDF and a short answers doc. seems blank on key rotation and retention. here: https://files.internal/telemetrypro/caqi-partial.pdf
Amy (platform): quick skim — SDK init shows device_id + session_token collection by default. curious if tokens are hashed before send. also what about offline batching? can devs disable pii collection?
Tom (devops): where does telemetry live? which region, S3/DB, and retention policy? can we self-host or run in our VPC for the POC?
TelemetryPro (vendor): Hi all — TelemetryPro here. We store telemetry in our secure region clusters (US/EU). In-transit TLS1.2+, at-rest AES-256. We offer customer-managed keys (KMS) on enterprise plans and an API to purge data per request. SOC2 Type II report and subprocessor list attached: https://telemetrypro.example.com/sec/soc2.pdf and https://telemetrypro.example.com/sec/subprocessors.csv
Kira (eng-security): thanks. couple follow-ups: 1) can you confirm exact KMS provider and whether CMK (customer-managed key) supports rotation without data re-encryption downtime? 2) provide key rotation policy (frequency, procedures), 3) clarify whether analytics pipeline uses any external SaaS ML vendors (they must be listed as subprocessors), 4) provide DFD showing where raw PII flows and retention windows.
TelemetryPro (vendor): answers — KMS: AWS KMS; CMK supported, rotation via scheduled key rotation (90d). Rotation is seamless (envelope encryption). Pipeline uses an internal model for anonymization, plus a third-party enrichment vendor (listed in subprocessors.csv). DFD attached: https://telemetrypro.example.com/sec/dfd.png
Maya (legal): do they handle any PCI/PHI? need confirmation of data classifications they process and if they will sign our DPA + delete-on-request SLA. also require vulnerability disclosure and penetration test summary.
TelemetryPro (vendor): we do not process cardholder data or PHI by default. We process device identifiers, event timestamps, and optional user_id if app sends it. We will sign standard DPA, and we have a VDP + pen test summary (redacted) linked here: https://telemetrypro.example.com/sec/pen-test-2025.pdf
Amy (platform): SDK question — what's the init config? can we turn off session_id collection? snippet from their repo:
```js
Telemetry.init({
  apiKey: "REDACTED",
  collectDeviceId: true,
  batchSize: 50,
  useCustomerKey: false
})
```
Can they default to collectDeviceId=false for our POC?
TelemetryPro (vendor): yes — collectDeviceId is configurable. For POC we can provide a build with collectDeviceId=false and short retention window (24h) and disable enrichment calls.
Kira (eng-security): mitigation plan for now: 1) require SOC2 Type II report (got it), 2) require completed SIG/CAIQ (we have partial) — vendor to finish and mark controls for key management, access control, incident response, 3) customer-managed KMS option enabled for POC, 4) sandbox POC with collectDeviceId=false + redaction proxy in front to strip tokens, 5) confirm API for deletion and SLA, 6) ask for vulnerability disclosure timeline and patching windows.
Jordan (sales): timeline note — prospect expects POC next week. can TelemetryPro commit to final CAIQ + DFD + KMS confirmation within 72h? if so we can proceed and waive POC fees. :crossed_fingers:
TelemetryPro (vendor): we can provide completed CAIQ, DFD, and KMS confirmation within 48h. we'll also provide a temporary test instance in our EU region for the POC.
Maya (legal): once CAIQ + SOC2 + subprocessors look good I'll draft vendor addendum and DPA changes (short retention + deletion SLA). we also need proof of pen test remediation for high findings.
Kira (eng-security): ok — assign risk rating pending final docs. temporary controls: sandbox + redaction + CMK. I'll create a short checklist and put follow-up in eng-security. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
